properties.title: Darkhovin Nuclear Plant Strike
properties.summary: CENTCOM strike on Darkhovin NPP construction site (Iran claims). IAEA investigating. No nuclear material confirmed at site.

properties.title: Qeshm Island Explosions
properties.summary: Multiple explosions reported on Qeshm Island, Hormozgan Province. IRGC-linked Fars News Agency confirmed.

properties.title: IRGC Claim: Al-Ahmadi Port Strike
properties.summary: IRGC claimed strike on US Navy fuel support pier, Kuwait Al-Ahmadi port. Regional govts had not confirmed damage.

properties.title: IRGC Claim: Sheikh Isa Air Base
properties.summary: IRGC claimed strike on US aircraft positions at Sheikh Isa Air Base, Bahrain. Not independently confirmed.

properties.title: Russian KAB Strike - Zaporizhzhia
properties.summary: Russian glide-bomb strike on Zaporizhzhia city: 2 killed, 42 wounded including 8 children. Residential buildings destroyed.

properties.title: Kyiv Air Alerts (Night 2)
properties.summary: Ballistic missile threats triggered air alerts in Kyiv and multiple oblasts for second consecutive night.

properties.title: Crimean Bridge Closure
properties.summary: Crimean Bridge reportedly closed again, social media reports of drone strikes on occupied Yalta.

properties.title: Russian Strike: MV Golden Leo
properties.summary: Russian cruise missiles (Kh-59/69) struck Turkish grain carrier Golden Leo exiting Ukraine maritime corridor. 5 killed, 5 missing.

properties.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike - Elektrostal
properties.summary: Large fire at Wildberries warehouse, Elektrostal, Moscow region after drone strikes.

properties.title: M5.5 Earthquake - Peru
properties.summary: GDACS Orange alert. Magnitude 5.5, depth 10km. At least 6 dead.

properties.title: MV Barima Ferry Capsize - Guyana
properties.summary: MV Barima (116 passengers + 17 crew) capsized off Guyana north coast. 50+ rescued, dozens missing including 15 children.

properties.title: Washington State Wildfire - Nespelem
properties.summary: Wildfire exploded to 72 sq miles threatening town of Nespelem. Cross-section high-confidence signal.

properties.title: São Tomé Presidential Election
properties.summary: Voting underway July 19. Five candidates. Incumbent Carlos Vila Nova favored. Results pending Monday.

properties.title: 2 US Service Members KIA - Jordan
properties.summary: Two US service members killed in action in Jordan on July 17. CENTCOM confirmed via press release.

properties.title: Lebanon: Israel Withdrawal Negotiations
properties.summary: Lebanese president says work underway to secure Israeli withdrawal and deploy Lebanese army to border. Large explosion heard in southern Lebanon.

properties.title: Houthi Ballistic Missiles - Yemen
properties.summary: Houthi missiles targeted Qatar and Saudi Arabia; Qatar and KSA air defenses intercepted. Earlier strikes on Sanaa airport area.

properties.title: Iranian Missile - Prince Sultan AB (claimed)
properties.summary: Iran claimed ballistic missile targeting of Prince Sultan Air Base, Al-Kharj, south of Riyadh. Not independently confirmed.
